C0143.title: Resale of a Game Account and Subsequent Recovery Leads to Theft Conviction
C0143.summary: In October 2022, the Shanghai No. 2 Intermediate People's Court sentenced a player for theft. The player sold a game account and then recovered it through means such as filing a complaint, illegally possessing the already-sold virtual property, which constituted the crime of theft. This case clarifies that game accounts are protected by law as virtual property, and recovering an account after sale
